chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:

Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام used to say: “The likeness of the weapon among us is only like the Ark among the Children of Israel. Wherever the Ark turned, prophethood was given; and wherever the weapon turns among us, there is the authority.”
I said, “So does the weapon become separate from knowledge?” He عليه السلام said, “No.”

key_terms.التَّابُوتِ: the Ark, used here as a parallel sign among the Children of Israel
key_terms.السِّلَاحِ: the weapon, a sign of rightful authority among the Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.النُّبُوَّةَ: prophethood, the divine office associated with the Ark in the comparison
key_terms.الْأَمْرُ: the authority or command, referring here to divine leadership
key_terms.الْعِلْمِ: knowledge, the divinely granted knowledge inseparable from true authority
key_terms.بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: the Children of Israel, cited as a historical comparison

ai.seo_question: How does the hadith compare the weapon of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام to the Ark of Banī Isrāʾīl?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the weapon as a sign of divinely designated authority among the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, just as the Ark signified sacred authority among the Children of Israel. It also clarifies that this sign is not independent of knowledge, indicating that true leadership remains joined with divinely bestowed knowledge.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘But rather an example of the weapons among us<sup>asws</sup> is an example of the Ark among the Children of Israel. Wherever the Ark went, the Prophet-hood was Given, and wherever the weapons go to among us<sup>asws</sup>, so does the Divine Authority’.
I said, ‘So do the weapons happen to be counterparts of the Knowledge?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan from abu a1-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) would say, ‘The case of the Armaments with us is as the Ark with the Israelites. Wherever the Ark would go prophet-hood would also follow. Wherever the Armaments among us would go the matter (leadership with Divine authority) would also settle there.”
I then asked, “Would the Armaments ever depart knowledge?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “No, it would not do so.”
